This powerful Wi-Fi CCTV camera for home outdoor use delivers crisp 4MP Full HD footage and offers motorized 360° pan and tilt control, eliminating blind spots and replacing the need for multiple CCTV cameras. With advanced smart motion tracking, human body detection, and sound detection, this wireless CCTV camera sends precise alerts only when real threats occur. Unlike traditional IR cameras, it features full-color night vision with built-in white LEDs that enhance visibility even in complete darkness. Engineered with CTC Cyber Secure Technology, this Wi-Fi camera protects your footage through encrypted data transmission, anti-tamper firmware, and secure boot protocols—keeping your camera safe from cyber threats. A built-in siren alerts intruders in real-time, while compatibility with Google Home & Alexa enables smart home integration and voice control.
